episode_title: CBD, Hemp & Vape Regulations: What Business Owners Need to Know | B2B Vault

real_qa.q: What are the new federal CBD and hemp regulations under the 0.4 milligrams dry weight threshold?
real_qa.r: The federal law changed from measuring THC at 0.3% liquid weight to 0.4 milligrams dry weight per container. Synthetics are no longer allowed, and CBD merchants must redo all their Certificates of Analysis and repackage products to stay under the 0.4 milligrams THC per container limit, since it is now measured by total THC per container rather than by strength percentage.
real_qa.requete: CBD federal law 0.4 milligrams dry weight requirement

real_qa.q: What happened to VIP Smoke Shops and what charges did they face?
real_qa.r: VIP Smoke Shops, operating over 100 stores across Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana, pleaded guilty to drug trafficking and organized crime-related charges on September 22nd. The investigation revealed products with THC levels higher than allowed, sales of psilocybin mushrooms, and sales to minors. All stores must be sold or closed by December 1st following a two-year investigation that began in 2024.
real_qa.requete: VIP Smoke Shops shutdown September 2024 charges

real_qa.q: What is the MATCH list and how does it affect merchants selling vape and CBD products?
real_qa.r: The MATCH list is maintained by MasterCard and contains merchants flagged as high-risk. Being on the list makes it very difficult to obtain credit card processing, and when processing is available, it costs significantly more. Merchants placed on MATCH due to vape and ENDS-related issues have been forced to sell their businesses, particularly gas station owners whose inside-store margins depend on credit card processing.
real_qa.requete: MasterCard MATCH list vape merchants processing

real_qa.q: When did Square discontinue its CBD processing program and what was the effective date?
real_qa.r: Square announced on August 21st, 2026 that it was winding down its CBD program and would prohibit CBD and hemp-derived sales on its platform both online and in person once the federal law takes effect. The key implementation date for these new regulations is November 12th.
real_qa.requete: Square CBD program discontinuation date August 2026

real_qa.q: What penalties and fines are credit card processors imposing on merchants for unauthorized vaping products?
real_qa.r: Credit card networks are issuing penalties and fines to merchants ranging from 2,500 to 5,000 dollars for selling unauthorized vaping products (ENDS). These fines are passed down the chain from card brands to banks to processors to merchants, and processors typically do not dispute them with the card brands.
real_qa.requete: credit card processing fines vape ENDS merchants 2500 5000
